comment.en: The main cause is strong wind/crosswind: a land typhoon warning is in effect, and the airport forecast (TAF) gives gusts of 33 kt and a crosswind of 32.4 kt for 10/24 08:00-14:00, while the airport observation (METAR) already reports gusts of 30 kt and wind shear on all runways; four of six models say Medium or above. After 10/24 20:00 the airport forecast drops the mean wind to 10 kt and all models say Low. Disruption risk is rated High, concentrated in the daytime of 10/24.

comment.en: The disruption risk is High, mainly due to strong winds and crosswind. From 10/24 08:00 to 10/25 02:00 local, official ratings are High under the land typhoon warning for Typhoon Champi and the strong wind advisory. During 10/24 08:00–14:00, the airport forecast (TAF) shows gusts of 33 kt and crosswind of 32.4 kt, while four of six models indicate Medium or above (Japanese model estimated gusts 55.6 kt, German model gusts 37.9 kt). Winds weaken from 10/24 14:00, dropping to Low risk after 10/25 02:00.
